name: Advanced Vocab 05 - Finance, Business & AWM Domain

cards.definition: Something of value owned by a person or company (संपत्ति)
cards.exampleSentence: Equities and bonds are the fund's main assets.

cards.definition: A financial obligation or debt (देयता)
cards.exampleSentence: The pension scheme is a long-term liability.

cards.definition: Ownership share in a company; also fairness (इक्विटी / हिस्सेदारी)
cards.exampleSentence: The fund holds equity in several technology firms.

cards.definition: Investments paying regular, predictable returns such as bonds (निश्चित आय वाले निवेश)
cards.exampleSentence: Fixed income provides stability to the portfolio.

cards.definition: A loan to a company or government that pays interest (बॉन्ड)
cards.exampleSentence: The bond matures in ten years.

cards.definition: The income return on an investment (प्रतिफल)
cards.exampleSentence: The yield on government bonds fell last week.

cards.definition: The interest payment made on a bond (बॉन्ड का ब्याज भुगतान)
cards.exampleSentence: The bond pays a five percent annual coupon.

cards.definition: The date when a financial instrument becomes payable (परिपक्वता तिथि)
cards.exampleSentence: The instrument reaches maturity in March.

cards.definition: A share of profits paid to shareholders (लाभांश)
cards.exampleSentence: The company announced a higher dividend this quarter.

cards.definition: Spreading investments to reduce risk (निवेश का विविधीकरण)
cards.exampleSentence: Diversification protects against a single market falling.

cards.definition: The distribution of funds among different investments (धन का वितरण)
cards.exampleSentence: Our allocation to equities is sixty percent.

cards.definition: To adjust a portfolio back to its target mix (पोर्टफ़ोलियो को लक्ष्य अनुपात में लाना)
cards.exampleSentence: The fund rebalances at the end of every quarter.

cards.definition: A standard against which performance is measured (तुलना का मानक सूचकांक)
cards.exampleSentence: The fund outperformed its benchmark index by two percent.

cards.definition: To achieve worse returns than expected (अपेक्षा से कमज़ोर प्रदर्शन करना)
cards.exampleSentence: The sector underperformed after the rate announcement.

cards.definition: The gain or loss on an investment (निवेश पर लाभ/हानि)
cards.exampleSentence: The annual return was eight percent.

cards.definition: The level of risk an investor is willing to accept (जोखिम सहने की क्षमता)
cards.exampleSentence: Her low risk appetite favours bonds.

cards.definition: The degree of price fluctuation (मूल्य में उतार-चढ़ाव)
cards.exampleSentence: Market volatility rose after the announcement.

cards.definition: How easily an asset can be converted into cash (नकदी में बदलने की आसानी)
cards.exampleSentence: Low liquidity makes the bond hard to sell quickly.

cards.definition: Not easily sold or converted to cash (आसानी से नकद में न बदलने वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: Real estate is an illiquid asset.

cards.definition: The amount of money at risk in an investment (जोखिम में लगी राशि)
cards.exampleSentence: Our exposure to emerging markets is limited.

cards.definition: To reduce risk by making an offsetting investment (जोखिम से बचाव करना)
cards.exampleSentence: The firm hedges currency risk using forward contracts.

cards.definition: A financial contract whose value depends on another asset (व्युत्पन्न अनुबंध)
cards.exampleSentence: Derivatives are used to manage price risk.

cards.definition: Contracts to buy or sell an asset at a future date and price (वायदा अनुबंध)
cards.exampleSentence: Oil futures rose sharply this morning.

cards.definition: A contract giving the right to buy or sell at a set price (विकल्प अनुबंध)
cards.exampleSentence: He bought an option to protect against a fall.

cards.definition: A basic raw material that is traded (वस्तु / कमोडिटी)
cards.exampleSentence: Gold is the most widely traded commodity.

cards.definition: A tradable financial instrument such as a share or bond (प्रतिभूति)
cards.exampleSentence: Each security has a unique identifier.

cards.definition: A short code identifying a publicly traded company (शेयर का संक्षिप्त कोड)
cards.exampleSentence: The ticker for the company changed after the merger.

cards.definition: A unique code used to recognise an instrument (पहचान कोड)
cards.exampleSentence: ISIN is a global identifier for securities.

cards.definition: An event by a company affecting its shares, such as a split (कंपनी द्वारा की गई शेयर संबंधी कार्रवाई)
cards.exampleSentence: Corporate actions must be applied to historical prices.

cards.definition: Dividing existing shares into more shares (शेयर विभाजन)
cards.exampleSentence: The stock split doubled the number of shares.

cards.definition: The combining of two companies into one (विलय)
cards.exampleSentence: The merger changed the instrument's identifier.

cards.definition: One company purchasing another (अधिग्रहण)
cards.exampleSentence: The acquisition was completed last quarter.

cards.definition: Prices and related information about financial instruments (बाज़ार संबंधी मूल्य डेटा)
cards.exampleSentence: Market data arrives from dozens of vendors.

cards.definition: Static information describing instruments and entities (संदर्भ डेटा)
cards.exampleSentence: Reference data ensures consistency across systems.

cards.definition: A continuous stream of prices from a source (मूल्यों की निरंतर आपूर्ति)
cards.exampleSentence: The price feed was delayed by ten minutes.

cards.definition: A revised price replacing an earlier incorrect one (संशोधित मूल्य)
cards.exampleSentence: Vendors send a corrected price when errors are found.

cards.definition: Relating to the close of the trading day (दिन के अंत से संबंधित)
cards.exampleSentence: End-of-day prices are loaded by midnight.

cards.definition: Occurring within a single trading day (दिन के भीतर)
cards.exampleSentence: Intraday prices update every minute.

cards.definition: The smallest movement in a price (मूल्य में न्यूनतम बदलाव)
cards.exampleSentence: The system stores every tick for later analysis.

cards.definition: The price a buyer is willing to pay (खरीदार की बोली)
cards.exampleSentence: The bid was slightly below the last trade.

cards.definition: The price a seller is willing to accept (विक्रेता का मूल्य)
cards.exampleSentence: The ask price rose after the news.

cards.definition: The difference between bid and ask prices (बोली और मांग मूल्य का अंतर)
cards.exampleSentence: A wide spread signals low liquidity.

cards.definition: The completion of a trade through the exchange of money and assets (सौदे का निपटान)
cards.exampleSentence: Settlement usually occurs one business day after the trade.

cards.definition: Confirming and reconciling a trade before settlement (लेन-देन की पुष्टि प्रक्रिया)
cards.exampleSentence: The clearing house guarantees both sides of the trade.

cards.definition: An institution that safeguards financial assets (संपत्तियों का संरक्षक संस्थान)
cards.exampleSentence: The custodian holds the fund's securities securely.

cards.definition: The other party in a financial transaction (लेन-देन की दूसरी पार्टी)
cards.exampleSentence: We assess the counterparty's creditworthiness.

cards.definition: The ability of a borrower to repay debt (ऋण चुकाने की क्षमता)
cards.exampleSentence: The agency downgraded the firm's creditworthiness.

cards.definition: An assessment of credit quality (ऋण साख रेटिंग)
cards.exampleSentence: The bond has a high credit rating.

cards.definition: Failure to meet a debt obligation (भुगतान में चूक)
cards.exampleSentence: The risk of default rose after the downturn.

cards.definition: A transaction to buy or sell an asset (सौदा)
cards.exampleSentence: The trade was executed at the closing price.

cards.definition: To carry out a trade or instruction (सौदा या निर्देश पूरा करना)
cards.exampleSentence: The order was executed within seconds.

cards.definition: A list of buy and sell orders for an asset (खरीद-बिक्री आदेशों की सूची)
cards.exampleSentence: Depth in the order book shows market interest.

cards.definition: The amount of an asset held by an investor (किसी संपत्ति की धारित मात्रा)
cards.exampleSentence: The desk closed its position before the announcement.

cards.definition: Assets owned by an investor or fund (धारित संपत्तियाँ)
cards.exampleSentence: The report lists all the fund's holdings.

cards.definition: The per-share value of a fund after liabilities (शुद्ध संपत्ति मूल्य)
cards.exampleSentence: Net asset value is calculated after market close.

cards.definition: The total market value of assets a firm manages (प्रबंधन के अंतर्गत कुल संपत्ति)
cards.exampleSentence: The firm's AUM exceeded two trillion dollars.

cards.definition: Having a legal duty to act in a client's best interest (विश्वस्त के रूप में कर्तव्यबद्ध)
cards.exampleSentence: Advisers have a fiduciary duty to their clients.

cards.definition: Professional advice and services for managing a client's finances (संपत्ति प्रबंधन सेवाएँ)
cards.exampleSentence: The bank expanded its wealth management division.

cards.definition: Having a high level of personal wealth (उच्च निवल संपत्ति वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: The service targets high-net-worth individuals.

cards.definition: An organisation investing large sums on behalf of others (संस्थागत निवेशक)
cards.exampleSentence: Pension funds are major institutional investors.

cards.definition: An individual who invests their own money (खुदरा निवेशक)
cards.exampleSentence: Retail investors increased their trading activity.

cards.definition: A category of investments with similar characteristics (संपत्ति वर्ग)
cards.exampleSentence: Equities and bonds are different asset classes.

cards.definition: A fund traded on an exchange that tracks an index (एक्सचेंज पर कारोबार होने वाला फ़ंड)
cards.exampleSentence: The ETF tracks the top five hundred companies.

cards.definition: A pooled investment managed by professionals (म्यूचुअल फ़ंड)
cards.exampleSentence: The mutual fund charges a low annual fee.

cards.definition: A pooled investment using complex strategies for high returns (हेज फ़ंड)
cards.exampleSentence: The hedge fund bet against the currency.

cards.definition: A fund designed to match the performance of a market index (सूचकांक आधारित फ़ंड)
cards.exampleSentence: Index funds offer broad exposure at low cost.

cards.definition: The annual fee charged as a percentage of fund assets (फ़ंड का वार्षिक शुल्क अनुपात)
cards.exampleSentence: A lower expense ratio improves long-term returns.

cards.definition: Earning returns on both principal and accumulated returns (चक्रवृद्धि)
cards.exampleSentence: Compounding rewards patient, long-term investors.

cards.definition: A general rise in prices over time (मुद्रास्फीति)
cards.exampleSentence: Inflation reduces the purchasing power of savings.

cards.definition: A general fall in prices over time (अपस्फीति)
cards.exampleSentence: Deflation can discourage spending and investment.

cards.definition: The cost of borrowing or reward for saving money (ब्याज दर)
cards.exampleSentence: The central bank raised interest rates again.

cards.definition: Central bank actions controlling money supply and rates (मौद्रिक नीति)
cards.exampleSentence: Monetary policy aims to keep inflation stable.

cards.definition: Government spending and taxation decisions (राजकोषीय नीति)
cards.exampleSentence: Fiscal policy shapes public investment levels.

cards.definition: A significant decline in economic activity (आर्थिक मंदी)
cards.exampleSentence: The economy slipped into recession last year.

cards.definition: A return to growth after a downturn (आर्थिक सुधार)
cards.exampleSentence: The recovery has been slow but steady.

cards.definition: A period of rising prices (तेज़ी का बाज़ार)
cards.exampleSentence: The bull market lasted almost a decade.

cards.definition: A period of falling prices (मंदी का बाज़ार)
cards.exampleSentence: Investors panic during a bear market.

cards.definition: A short-term decline of around ten percent in prices (बाज़ार में अस्थायी गिरावट)
cards.exampleSentence: The market entered a correction after weak earnings.

cards.definition: A rapid sale of assets causing falling prices (तेज़ बिकवाली)
cards.exampleSentence: Fear triggered a broad sell-off in bonds.

cards.definition: The overall attitude of investors towards the market (निवेशकों का सामान्य रुझान)
cards.exampleSentence: Investor sentiment turned cautious.

cards.definition: Risky investing in hope of quick profit (जोखिम भरी अटकलबाज़ी)
cards.exampleSentence: Speculation drove prices far above fundamentals.

cards.definition: Basic financial factors that determine an asset's value (बुनियादी आर्थिक कारक)
cards.exampleSentence: The stock's fundamentals remain strong.

cards.definition: An estimate of the worth of an asset or company (मूल्यांकन)
cards.exampleSentence: The startup's valuation doubled in a year.

cards.definition: Priced higher than its worth (अपने मूल्य से अधिक कीमत वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: Analysts believe the stock is overvalued.

cards.definition: Priced lower than its worth (अपने मूल्य से कम कीमत वाला)
cards.exampleSentence: The company appears undervalued relative to peers.

cards.definition: Profit made by a company (कंपनी की कमाई)
cards.exampleSentence: Quarterly earnings beat expectations.

cards.definition: Total income from business activities (कुल राजस्व)
cards.exampleSentence: Revenue grew twelve percent year on year.

cards.definition: The difference between revenue and cost (लाभ का अंतर)
cards.exampleSentence: Higher costs squeezed the profit margin.

cards.definition: Ongoing business expenses not tied to a specific product (सामान्य परिचालन खर्च)
cards.exampleSentence: We reduced overhead costs by consolidating offices.

cards.definition: The movement of money in and out of a business (नकदी का प्रवाह)
cards.exampleSentence: Strong cash flow supports the dividend.

cards.definition: A statement of a company's assets and liabilities (तुलन पत्र)
cards.exampleSentence: The balance sheet shows low debt.

cards.definition: An independent examination of financial statements (लेखा परीक्षण रिपोर्ट)
cards.exampleSentence: The audit report found no material errors.

cards.definition: A rule made by authority to control behaviour (विनियमन)
cards.exampleSentence: New regulation increased reporting obligations.

cards.definition: An authority overseeing and enforcing rules (नियामक संस्था)
cards.exampleSentence: The regulator fined the firm for late reporting.

cards.definition: A person ensuring a firm follows laws and rules (अनुपालन अधिकारी)
cards.exampleSentence: The compliance officer reviewed the new policy.

cards.definition: Rules preventing illegally obtained money from entering the system (धनशोधन निरोधक)
cards.exampleSentence: Anti-money laundering checks apply to all new clients.

cards.definition: The process of verifying a client's identity (ग्राहक पहचान सत्यापन)
cards.exampleSentence: KYC must be completed before opening an account.

cards.definition: Detailed investigation of a client or investment (विस्तृत जाँच प्रक्रिया)
cards.exampleSentence: The due diligence process takes several weeks.

cards.definition: The act of revealing information as required (आवश्यक जानकारी का खुलासा)
cards.exampleSentence: Full disclosure of fees is required by law.

cards.definition: Openness in sharing information (पारदर्शिता)
cards.exampleSentence: Transparency builds client confidence.

cards.definition: A situation where personal gain may affect duty (हितों का टकराव)
cards.exampleSentence: Advisers must declare any conflict of interest.

cards.definition: Illegal trading based on confidential information (अंदरूनी जानकारी पर कारोबार)
cards.exampleSentence: Insider trading is a serious criminal offence.

cards.definition: Environmental, social and governance criteria used to assess investments (पर्यावरण, सामाजिक व शासन मानदंड)
cards.exampleSentence: ESG factors increasingly influence investment decisions.

cards.definition: Investing that considers long-term environmental and social impact (टिकाऊ निवेश)
cards.exampleSentence: Sustainable investing attracted record inflows.

cards.definition: Responsible management of entrusted assets (ज़िम्मेदार प्रबंधन)
cards.exampleSentence: Investors expect strong stewardship from asset managers.

cards.definition: Measured after taking the level of risk into account (जोखिम के अनुसार समायोजित)
cards.exampleSentence: Risk-adjusted returns tell a fuller story.

cards.definition: Returns above those of a benchmark (मानक से अधिक अतिरिक्त प्रतिफल)
cards.exampleSentence: The manager has consistently generated alpha.

cards.definition: A measure of how much an asset moves with the market (बाज़ार के साथ चाल का माप)
cards.exampleSentence: A beta above one means higher volatility than the market.

cards.definition: The decline from a portfolio's peak to its low (शीर्ष से गिरावट)
cards.exampleSentence: The maximum drawdown was fifteen percent.

cards.definition: Simulating extreme conditions to test resilience (चरम परिस्थितियों का अनुकरण परीक्षण)
cards.exampleSentence: Banks must pass annual stress tests.

cards.definition: Evaluating outcomes under different assumed conditions (विभिन्न परिस्थितियों में नतीजों का विश्लेषण)
cards.exampleSentence: Scenario analysis shows how losses change if rates rise.

cards.definition: An estimate of the potential loss over a period (संभावित अधिकतम हानि अनुमान)
cards.exampleSentence: The model estimates value at risk at ninety-five percent confidence.

cards.definition: The risk of rare but extreme events (दुर्लभ पर गंभीर घटना का जोखिम)
cards.exampleSentence: Tail risk is easy to ignore until it happens.

cards.definition: An unpredictable event with severe consequences (अप्रत्याशित बड़ी घटना)
cards.exampleSentence: The pandemic was a classic black swan event.

cards.definition: The risk that the failure of one entity collapses the system (तंत्रगत जोखिम)
cards.exampleSentence: Regulators monitor systemic risk in large banks.

cards.definition: The spread of financial trouble from one market to another (संकट का फैलना)
cards.exampleSentence: Fears of contagion hit neighbouring economies.

cards.definition: Financial rescue of a failing company (वित्तीय बचाव पैकेज)
cards.exampleSentence: The government arranged a bailout for the bank.

cards.definition: The inability to pay debts (दिवालियापन)
cards.exampleSentence: The company filed for insolvency after losing its biggest client.

cards.definition: Legal status of being unable to repay debts (दिवालिया घोषित होना)
cards.exampleSentence: The retailer declared bankruptcy last month.

cards.definition: To reorganise finances or operations (पुनर्गठन करना)
cards.exampleSentence: The company restructured its debt to avoid default.

cards.definition: Merging of companies or financial statements (समेकन)
cards.exampleSentence: Industry consolidation reduced the number of vendors.

cards.definition: Selling off assets or business units (संपत्ति की बिक्री)
cards.exampleSentence: The divestment of the unit raised two billion dollars.

cards.definition: Money or assets used to generate income (पूँजी)
cards.exampleSentence: The startup raised capital from investors.

cards.definition: Spending on long-term assets (दीर्घकालिक संपत्ति पर खर्च)
cards.exampleSentence: Capital expenditure rose due to new data centres.

cards.definition: Ongoing cost of running a business (परिचालन व्यय)
cards.exampleSentence: Cloud usage is a major operating expense.

cards.definition: A plan of expected income and spending (बजट)
cards.exampleSentence: The budget for next year was cut by ten percent.

cards.definition: A prediction of future conditions (पूर्वानुमान)
cards.exampleSentence: The forecast assumes steady growth.

cards.definition: An estimate of future figures based on current trends (अनुमानित आँकड़ा)
cards.exampleSentence: Revenue projections look conservative.

cards.definition: The difference between planned and actual figures (योजना और वास्तविकता का अंतर)
cards.exampleSentence: The variance in costs was mainly due to licences.

cards.definition: The point at which income equals costs (लाभ-हानि रहित बिंदु)
cards.exampleSentence: The product should reach break-even within a year.

cards.definition: A measure of profit relative to cost (निवेश पर प्रतिफल)
cards.exampleSentence: The automation had a strong return on investment.

cards.definition: Comparing the costs of an action with its benefits (लागत-लाभ विश्लेषण)
cards.exampleSentence: A cost-benefit analysis supported the upgrade.

cards.definition: The process of acquiring goods or services (ख़रीद प्रक्रिया)
cards.exampleSentence: Procurement approved the new vendor contract.

cards.definition: A company that supplies goods or services (विक्रेता / आपूर्तिकर्ता)
cards.exampleSentence: We onboard a new data vendor every month.

cards.definition: A formal offer to supply goods or services at a stated price (निविदा)
cards.exampleSentence: The firm won the tender for the platform upgrade.

cards.definition: Relating to a legally binding agreement (अनुबंध संबंधी)
cards.exampleSentence: Late delivery is a contractual breach.

cards.definition: A duty or commitment (दायित्व)
cards.exampleSentence: We have an obligation to protect client data.

cards.definition: A contract term imposing a fine for breaching conditions (दंड खंड)
cards.exampleSentence: The penalty clause applies if delivery is late.

cards.definition: Power to influence the terms of a deal (वार्ता में बढ़त)
cards.exampleSentence: Multiple vendors give us stronger negotiating leverage.

cards.definition: Extension of a contract or licence for another period (नवीनीकरण)
cards.exampleSentence: The licence renewal is due in April.

cards.definition: Official permission to use something (लाइसेंस)
cards.exampleSentence: The licence limits usage to ten users.

cards.definition: A recurring payment for access to a service (सदस्यता)
cards.exampleSentence: The data subscription costs twenty thousand per month.

cards.definition: Pricing that varies by usage or level (स्तरवार मूल्य निर्धारण)
cards.exampleSentence: Tiered pricing makes the service cheaper at higher volumes.

cards.definition: A price reduction for large purchases (अधिक मात्रा पर छूट)
cards.exampleSentence: We negotiated a volume discount from the vendor.

cards.definition: A graph of bond yields across different maturities (परिपक्वता के अनुसार बॉन्ड प्रतिफल का ग्राफ़)
cards.exampleSentence: An inverted yield curve often signals a slowdown.

cards.definition: One hundredth of one percent (एक प्रतिशत का सौवाँ भाग)
cards.exampleSentence: The bank raised rates by fifty basis points.

cards.definition: Government debt securities or finance department (सरकारी प्रतिभूतियाँ / कोषागार)
cards.exampleSentence: Investors moved money into treasuries.

cards.definition: Money borrowed by a national government (सरकारी ऋण)
cards.exampleSentence: Sovereign debt worries unsettled markets.

cards.definition: The yield difference between corporate and government bonds (कॉर्पोरेट व सरकारी बॉन्ड के प्रतिफल का अंतर)
cards.exampleSentence: Credit spreads widened during the crisis.

cards.definition: Bonds with a low risk of default (कम जोखिम वाले बॉन्ड वर्ग का)
cards.exampleSentence: The fund only buys investment grade bonds.

cards.definition: A high-risk, high-yield bond (उच्च जोखिम वाला बॉन्ड)
cards.exampleSentence: Junk bonds pay more but carry default risk.

cards.definition: A market where shares are traded (शेयर बाज़ार)
cards.exampleSentence: Equity markets rallied after the announcement.

cards.definition: A large, reliable, well-established company (बड़ी व भरोसेमंद कंपनी)
cards.exampleSentence: Blue chip stocks suit cautious investors.

cards.definition: The total market value of a company's shares (कंपनी का कुल बाज़ार मूल्य)
cards.exampleSentence: Its market capitalisation exceeds one trillion dollars.

cards.definition: The first sale of a company's shares to the public (कंपनी के शेयरों की पहली सार्वजनिक बिक्री)
cards.exampleSentence: The start-up plans an initial public offering next year.

cards.definition: A company repurchasing its own shares (कंपनी द्वारा अपने शेयर वापस ख़रीदना)
cards.exampleSentence: The share buyback lifted the stock price.

cards.definition: A market where securities are bought and sold (स्टॉक एक्सचेंज)
cards.exampleSentence: The stock exchange closes at three-thirty.

cards.definition: Adjusting an index's holdings to match rules (सूचकांक की संरचना में समायोजन)
cards.exampleSentence: Index rebalancing triggered heavy trading.

cards.definition: The difference between a fund's and its benchmark's returns (फ़ंड और मानक के प्रतिफल का अंतर)
cards.exampleSentence: Low tracking error indicates faithful replication.

cards.definition: Investing to match a market index rather than beat it (सूचकांक के बराबर निवेश)
cards.exampleSentence: Passive investing has grown rapidly.

cards.definition: Choosing investments to try to beat the market (सक्रिय रूप से निवेश चुनना)
cards.exampleSentence: Active management charges higher fees.

cards.definition: A firm that provides buy and sell quotes to ensure liquidity (क्रय-विक्रय भाव देने वाली संस्था)
cards.exampleSentence: Market makers keep spreads narrow.

cards.definition: A private venue for trading large blocks of shares (बड़े सौदों के लिए निजी मंच)
cards.exampleSentence: Large orders often route through dark pools.

cards.definition: Very fast automated trading using algorithms (तेज़ गति से स्वचालित ट्रेडिंग)
cards.exampleSentence: High-frequency trading depends on microsecond latency.

cards.definition: Trading using automated rules (एल्गोरिदम आधारित ट्रेडिंग)
cards.exampleSentence: Algorithmic trading now dominates equity volume.

cards.definition: The difference between expected and actual trade price (अपेक्षित व वास्तविक सौदा मूल्य का अंतर)
cards.exampleSentence: Slippage rose during the volatile open.

cards.definition: A demand to add funds to cover losses (नुक़सान की भरपाई हेतु अतिरिक्त धन की माँग)
cards.exampleSentence: He faced a margin call after the sharp fall.

cards.definition: Selling borrowed assets expecting prices to fall (उधार लेकर बेचना, गिरावट की उम्मीद में)
cards.exampleSentence: Short selling can increase market volatility.

cards.definition: Owning an asset expecting its price to rise (कीमत बढ़ने की उम्मीद में धारित स्थिति)
cards.exampleSentence: The fund holds a long position in energy stocks.

cards.definition: Profiting from price differences in different markets (मूल्य अंतर से लाभ कमाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Arbitrage keeps prices aligned across exchanges.

cards.definition: Valuing assets at current market prices (वर्तमान बाज़ार मूल्य पर मूल्यांकन)
cards.exampleSentence: Positions are marked to market every evening.

cards.definition: The provider from which a price is taken (मूल्य का स्रोत)
cards.exampleSentence: We define a primary and fallback pricing source.

cards.definition: A price that has not been updated recently (पुराना न बदला हुआ मूल्य)
cards.exampleSentence: A stale price distorted the portfolio valuation.

cards.definition: The permitted variation before a price is flagged (मूल्य में स्वीकार्य अंतर)
cards.exampleSentence: The check flags moves beyond the price tolerance.

cards.definition: The permission to use a data vendor's information (डेटा विक्रेता की जानकारी उपयोग की अनुमति)
cards.exampleSentence: Vendor entitlement limits which teams can see raw feeds.

cards.definition: Legal permission to use specific data (डेटा उपयोग की क़ानूनी अनुमति)
cards.exampleSentence: The data licence restricts redistribution.

cards.definition: Passing data to parties outside the licence (लाइसेंस से बाहर डेटा साझा करना)
cards.exampleSentence: Redistribution of vendor data is not allowed.

cards.definition: The price of one currency in terms of another (विनिमय दर)
cards.exampleSentence: The exchange rate moved against the rupee.

cards.definition: Reducing risk from currency movements (मुद्रा जोखिम से बचाव)
cards.exampleSentence: Currency hedging protects overseas returns.

cards.definition: The market for trading national currencies (विदेशी मुद्रा बाज़ार)
cards.exampleSentence: Foreign exchange trading runs around the clock.

cards.definition: A currency held widely by central banks (आरक्षित मुद्रा)
cards.exampleSentence: The dollar is the main reserve currency.

cards.definition: Government-issued money not backed by a physical commodity (सरकार द्वारा जारी मुद्रा)
cards.exampleSentence: Most modern money is fiat currency.

cards.definition: Central bank purchasing assets to increase money supply (केंद्रीय बैंक द्वारा मुद्रा आपूर्ति बढ़ाने की प्रक्रिया)
cards.exampleSentence: Quantitative easing lowered long-term rates.

cards.definition: An increase in interest rates (ब्याज दर में वृद्धि)
cards.exampleSentence: A rate hike cooled the housing market.

cards.definition: Slowing inflation without causing recession (मंदी के बिना महँगाई घटाना)
cards.exampleSentence: Policymakers aim for a soft landing.

cards.definition: A sharp economic downturn after tightening (तीव्र आर्थिक गिरावट)
cards.exampleSentence: A hard landing would hurt employment.

cards.definition: High inflation combined with slow growth and unemployment (महँगाई के साथ धीमी वृद्धि)
cards.exampleSentence: Stagflation is difficult for policymakers to tackle.

cards.definition: A sudden reduction in available loans (ऋण उपलब्धता में अचानक कमी)
cards.exampleSentence: The credit crunch froze lending.

cards.definition: A shortage of cash or easily sellable assets (नकदी का संकट)
cards.exampleSentence: A liquidity crisis forced the fund to halt withdrawals.

cards.definition: A rush of customers withdrawing money (बैंक से एक साथ पैसे निकालने की भीड़)
cards.exampleSentence: Rumours triggered a run on the bank.

cards.definition: So large that its collapse would harm the economy (इतना बड़ा कि गिरने नहीं दिया जा सकता)
cards.exampleSentence: Regulators fear banks that are too big to fail.

cards.definition: Taking risks because someone else bears the cost (दूसरे के जोखिम उठाने की वजह से लापरवाही)
cards.exampleSentence: Bailouts can create moral hazard.

cards.definition: An asset expected to hold value in turbulent times (मुश्किल समय में सुरक्षित निवेश)
cards.exampleSentence: Gold is considered a safe haven.

cards.definition: Investors moving money to safer assets (सुरक्षित संपत्तियों की ओर पलायन)
cards.exampleSentence: There was a flight to quality as fears grew.

cards.definition: Market mood in which investors avoid risk (जोखिम से बचने का बाज़ार रुझान)
cards.exampleSentence: It was a risk-off day for equities.

cards.definition: Market mood in which investors seek higher returns (जोखिम उठाने का बाज़ार रुझान)
cards.exampleSentence: Risk-on sentiment pushed tech stocks higher.

cards.definition: Factors making progress more difficult (प्रतिकूल परिस्थितियाँ)
cards.exampleSentence: The sector faces regulatory headwinds.

cards.definition: Factors helping progress (अनुकूल परिस्थितियाँ)
cards.exampleSentence: Lower rates provided tailwinds for growth.

cards.definition: Borrowing in a low-interest currency to invest in a higher-yielding one (कम ब्याज में उधार लेकर अधिक ब्याज वाली मुद्रा में निवेश)
cards.exampleSentence: The carry trade unwound sharply when rates changed.

cards.definition: The total return of a bond if held until it matures (परिपक्वता तक रखने पर बॉन्ड का कुल प्रतिफल)
cards.exampleSentence: The yield to maturity is higher than the coupon rate.
